premises.text: Farmers urgently need new resilient varieties because climate crop failures are rising while agricultural output must increase sharply
premises.evidence_span: we're expecting a massive uptick in the number of climate-related crop failures

premises.text: Finding useful gene targets with GWAS is unreliable and producing a variety via GMO or traditional breeding takes years and large capital
premises.evidence_span: it's at least five years and up to $100 million to produce even a simple genetically modified variety

premises.text: Interpretable ML opens black-box models of natural selection history to identify causal gene targets with about 90% precision
premises.evidence_span: use techniques from interpretable machine learning to open up what would have otherwise been black box models

premises.text: AI recommendations simulate crosses, forecast outcomes, and cut discovery and development time dramatically with far less data
premises.evidence_span: lets us increase the process of discovery and development by up to 77%

premises.text: Lower cost and time make previously uneconomic crops feasible and support partner pipeline insertion plus own seed products
premises.evidence_span: even crops that were too complicated or too costly to work on are now economically feasible for us

domains.name: Climate-resilient crop demand and slow breeding

value.text: Deliver new productive crop varieties to farmers much faster and cheaper
value.evidence_span: accelerate the creation of new and productive crop varieties

secondary_value.text: Plant the seeds for a greener, more sustainable tomorrow
secondary_value.evidence_span: join us in planting the seeds for a greener tomorrow

causal_links.evidence_span: We're just not going to meet the needs of billions of people in time
identify causal gene targets with 90% precision
forecast plant outcomes before they even happen
get our technology into their existing breeding pipelines

notes: Split discovery vs recommendation as separately learnable tech modules (speaker validates crosses as a distinct stage). Academic bio excluded. Greenhouse broccoli demo not a premise. Singletons D2–D4 retained with independent paths to faster variety creation.
